native_result.HypoA: Around 1800 BCE, Diversity in Pottery Form collapses, while Diversity in Pottery Decoration increases.
native_result.HypoB: Diversity in Pottery Form collapsed by -1.87 Z and Diversity in Pottery Decoration rose by +1.45 Z simultaneously in the 18th century BCE (1800-1701 BCE), as the unique century in time_series_data.csv where deltaForm < 0 and deltaDecoration > 0 co-occur. The collapse is observed as the transition from the 1800 BCE endpoint (PotteryForm = +0.74, PotteryDecoration = -0.48) to the 1700 BCE endpoint (PotteryForm = -1.13, PotteryDecoration = +0.97); cross-checked against capital.csv ZKeform/Zkeverz with exact agreement (deltaForm_capital = -1.87, deltaDec_capital = +1.45) and confirmed by a bin-mean robustness check on PotteryForm_inter / PotteryDecoration_inter (18th c.
